spans.s: 2. इष् ifc. mfn. moving quickly, speedy. See अरम्-इष्.
[with इष् cf. Old Germ. eiscôm, ‘I ask’; Mod. Germ. heische; Angl.Sax. ásciani cf. also Gk. ἰό-της, ἵμερος; Lith. jëskóti; Russ. iskate, ‘to seek’.]
4. इष् mfn. ifc. seeking for (see गव्-इष्, पश्व्-इष्, &c.)
wish, Hariv. [cf. इट्-चर].
5. इष् f. anything drunk, a draught, refreshment, enjoyment
libation
the refreshing waters of the sky
sap, strength, freshness, comfort, increase
good condition, affluence, RV.; AV.; VS.; AitBr.
an interjection of anger or pain or sorrow, L.
(according to BRD. इस् Ved. = निस् cf. इष्-√ कृ above.)
1. ईश् cl. 2. Ā. ई॑ष्टे, or Ved. ई॑शे (2. sg. ई॑शिषे and ई॑क्षे, RV. iv, 20, 8; vi, 19, 10;
Pot. 1

etym.s: [cf. Goth. aigan, ‘to have’; Old Germ. eigan, ‘own’; Mod. Germ. eigen.]

spans.s: 2. ईश् m. master, lord, the supreme spirit, VS. &c.
N. of Śiva.
2. ईष् ind. a Nidhana or concluding chorus at the end of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
